entities.summary: Dylan Fabre is a French professional ice hockey player who is a winger for HC Ässät Pori of the Liiga. Internationally, Fabre represents France. Fabre started his professional career in the Ligue Magnus, France's top-level league, playing for Brûleurs de Loups, which is also his youth club.
